useNoiseFreeAudioForBest: Use noise-free audio for best results. For large files, "Auto Split" is faster.

apiKeyErrorOrQuotaExceeded: API Key Error or Quota exceeded. Please change Key in Settings.
selectGeminiModelForTranscriptionAnalysi: Select Gemini model for transcription & analysis
areYouSureYouWantTo: Are you sure you want to delete this key?
showOrHideTheLiveMicrophone: Show or hide the live microphone recording button in the left sidebar.
enableOrDisableSyncWithLocal: Enable or disable sync with local Apache/PHP server. When disabled, zero network calls are made to 127.0.0.1.
ifLeftEmptyFilesWillBe: If left empty, files will be saved in the project's "downloads" folder by default.
keyAddedAndSetAsActive: Key added and set as Active
inputSourcesHistoryAndFileInformation: Input sources, history and file information
localFileUploadFromPcYoutube:

viewPastWorkClickExpandArrow: View past work. Click expand arrow for full-screen search and filtering. Sensitive keywords are highlighted in red.
showsNameSizeDurationIncludesAudio: Shows name, size, duration. Includes audio player with speed controls and the main "Start Transcribe" button.
scissorsIconAccessCutterJoinerConverter: Scissors Icon: Access Cutter, Joiner, Converter, and Downloaders.
keyIconManageApiKeysLog: Key Icon: Manage API Keys. Log Icon: View system activity logs for debugging.
controlsForFullscreenThemeLanguageStatus: Controls for Fullscreen, Theme, Language, Status Indicator, and Refresh.
serverConnectionAndApiStatusMonitoring: Server connection and API status monitoring
greenXamppConnectedSavingDataRed: Green = XAMPP Connected (Saving data). Red = Offline (Data risk). Click to configure IP.
showsActiveApiKeyIndicatesIf: Shows active API Key. Indicates if using Auto-Rotation or a specific Manual Key.
modelCurrentAiEngineFlashPro: Model: Current AI engine (Flash/Pro). Calls: Total requests sent, helps track quota usage.
searchHighlightsTextAnalysisIconGives: Search highlights text. Analysis icon gives AI sentiment. Report icon generates official docs.
translateButtonFlipsLanguageUB: Translate button flips language. U/B button converts text between Unicode and Bijoy encoding.
adjustFontSizeWithButtonsDownload: Adjust font size with +/- buttons. Download as PDF, Word, Text, or SRT subtitles.
clickToUploadMultipleFiles: Click to upload multiple files (MP3, WAV, MP4, OPUS)
liveMicrophoneRecordingIsTemporarilyPaus: 🎙️ Live microphone recording is temporarily paused.
couldNotReachTheLocalServer: Could not reach the local server. Check that XAMPP is running and the server address in Settings.
loadingAudioFromALinkNeeds: Loading audio from a link needs your local server (XAMPP + yt-dlp). Turn it on in Settings → Cloud Sync.
dailyQuotaIsUsedUpOn: Daily quota is used up on every API key, so the batch was paused. Add a key or resume after the quota resets (midnight Pacific time).
doYouWantToTranscribeIt: Do you want to transcribe it again, or view the previous result?
microphoneRecordingIsDisabledInSettings: Microphone recording is disabled in Settings.
fileSizeCannotExceed500mbPlease: File size cannot exceed 500MB. Please compress the file from Tools.
firebaseUpToDate: All records up to date (Cloud total: {cloudTotal})
folderUploadConfirm: Found {supportedFilesCount} files. Do you want to start batch processing?
firebaseQuotaExceeded: Today's free Firebase read limit is used up. Try again after it resets (around 1-2 PM Bangladesh time).
firebasePullFailed: Could not read data from Firebase. Check the connection and try again.
